mapper.select: select afm.id, afm.name, afm.meta_key, afm.group_id, afm.search, afm.display, afm.type, afm.param, afm.remark, afg.name as afg_name, afg.id as afg_id from asset_field_meta afm left join asset_field_group afg on afm.group_id = afg.id where afm.id = #{id}

SELECT me.*, va.value, va.asset_id, mg.id as afg_id, mg.name as afg_name FROM asset_field_value va LEFT JOIN asset_field_meta me ON va.meta_id = me.id LEFT JOIN asset_field_group mg ON me.group_id = mg.id
va.asset_id = #{assetId}
